lines.text: Paul and Timothy write to the church of God in Corinth and wish them grace and peace.
God is the Father of compassion, who comforts us in all our troubles so we can comfort others.
As the sufferings of Christ overflow to us, our wisdom overflows through Christ, and our affliction is for the Corinthians' comfort and salvation.
In the province of Asia, Paul and Timothy were under a burden beyond their ability to endure and trusted in God, who calms the sea.
God delivered them from deadly peril and will deliver them again, as the Corinthians help by their prayers.
